args: $pluginRoot = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($pluginRoot)) { $pluginRoot = $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($pluginRoot)) { $pluginRoot = (Get-Location).Path }; $python = Get-Command python.exe, python -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $python) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('[ERROR] Python 3 was not found on PATH.'); exit 1 }; & $python.Source (Join-Path $pluginRoot 'scripts\mcp_server.py'); exit $LASTEXITCODE
